name: heading-core
description: Sovereignty and session core: the prime/state-check/checkpoint skills, the standalone sovereignty guard hooks, and the session checkpoint system - a context-usage sensor, a threshold offer, a pre-compaction brief that states what the summary must keep verbatim, a redacted post-compact save, and a resume injector, all keyed by session so concurrent sessions never overwrite each other. Two optional switches: a hands-off auto mode that saves without asking, and an unattended mode that waits out a grace period at a pause and carries on when nobody answers, bounded by a no-progress fuse and a continuation ceiling.
